No clear engine code/ID plate, VIN tag, or model number is readable in the photos.

claims.evidence: Photos show a 4-cylinder engine assembly but no readable Hyundai/Kia engine code or branding that confirms the exact make/family.

risks.risk: Exact engine variant/family is not identifiable from the photos (could be different 4-cylinder petrol engine with different fitment/ECU/sensors).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine block/ID stamping or engine code (e.g., on the block head/side) plus the intake manifold label.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic 4-cylinder engine assembly with worst-case fitment/unknown variant.

risks.risk: Unknown working condition (compression, timing, head gasket, internal knock) since photos only show the engine externally.
risks.proof: Video of a cold start (or at least cranking) and a compression test sheet (all cylinders) or mechanic test report.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case: needs overhaul/unknown condition).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories or wrong accessories for the target car (sensors, coils, alternator/PS/AC brackets, brackets/harness).
risks.proof: Photo checklist laid out: all sensors/ECU/ignition coils, alternator/PS/AC items, and a photo of the full engine with every connector visible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: may require sourcing missing sensors/brackets).

risks.risk: Mileage/usage history unknown; could be from accident/overheat leading to hidden damage.
risks.proof: Seller should provide source vehicle details (model/year) and any overheating/repair history; plus underside/head area photos.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without mileage assurance (worst case: unknown history).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/ID stamping on the block/head (must be readable).
Video of cold start/cranking (showing RPM and any warning lights) or a mechanic test report.
Compression test results for all cylinders (or leak-down test).
Photos showing all sensors/connectors and a full inventory of included accessories (alternator, PS pump, AC compressor, brackets, harness/ECU if included).
Photo of the timing area/chain/belt condition if accessible (or mechanic inspection note).
response.reason: The photos confirm a 4-cylinder engine assembly, but the exact Hyundai/Kia engine variant and working condition cannot be verified remotely; without the engine code and proof of operation, a reliable worst-case price pick from the comparables is not safe.
